title: Create: Advanced Optimization
description: Optimize and diagnose large Create factories, logistics, packages, trains, and processing systems with built-in profiling tools.
body:
Create: Advanced Optimization

A lightweight optimization and diagnostics mod for Create on NeoForge.

Built for large factories, logistics networks, package systems, trains, processing chains, and advanced Create worlds.

*** ## ⚙️ **Performance Improvements** Create is at its best when factories become huge, automated, interconnected… and slightly terrifying. Create: Advanced Optimization helps reduce unnecessary background workload in several commonly used Create systems, keeping advanced worlds smoother as your builds grow. * **Faster Spout processing** by optimizing repeated filling recipe lookups. * **Smarter Basin and Mechanical Crafter checks** to avoid unnecessary repeated recipe calculations. * **Reduced background workload** across selected Create systems. * **Better support for large factories**, processing lines, logistics networks, package deliveries, trains, and contraptions. * **Package Entity monitoring** to help detect overloaded logistics areas before they become a problem. * **Optimized Diving Boots checks** to remove small but repeated unnecessary operations. No recipes are changed. No machines are nerfed. No Create gameplay is altered. Just a cleaner, lighter experience for ambitious Create worlds. Create: Advanced Optimization does not change Create recipes, machines, progression, or gameplay. It simply reduces background workload where possible. ![MOD WEBLINK REPORT](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/21ecab0a0f5d20fdcad6a75bc6fb3d53088d548d_0.webp) *** ## 📦 **Package Entity Monitoring** Large package networks can become expensive on busy servers. The mod monitors active Package Entities and can help identify chunks with unusually high package counts. *** ## 📊 **Built-In Create Profiler** Profile your Create setup directly in-game and identify which systems take the most server time. * Factory and Smart Block Entity activity * Pipes, funnels, inventories, and Spouts * Package systems and global logistics * Chain Conveyors * Railway managers, trains, map sync, and track graphs * Redstone Links and other Create systems Each session exports a readable TXT report and a visual HTML report. Open the HTML file in a browser to view server health, MSPT, top hotspots, package data, alerts, and recommended checks. **See the Gallery for a preview of the HTML report.** *** ## 🛠️ **Commands** All commands require OP permission level 2. * `/cao status` - Shows enabled optimizations, profiler status, and package statistics. * `/cao profile start ` - Starts a Create profiling session from 5 to 3600 seconds. * `/cao profile stop` - Stops the active profiling session and exports a report. * `/cao report` - Exports a report from the latest available profiler data. * `/cao report last` - Shows information about the latest exported report. * `/cao packages top [limit]` - Lists chunks with the highest Package Entity count. * `/cao reset` - Resets profiler and package monitoring data. The full `/createadvancedoptimization` command is also available. *** ## ✅ **Requirements** * Minecraft 1.21.1 * NeoForge 21.1.233 or newer * Create 6.0.10 or newer *** ## **Feedback** Feedback, suggestions, and bug reports are welcome.
